summary: Add opt-in authenticated outbound home sessions for durable native Observe and Stop, with paired epoch fencing and replay

replay.detail: Session state uses a fresh versioned authoritative SQLite namespace. Existing full-node graph planning, replication and native start behavior are unchanged; no old graph or execution identity is replaced.

schema.detail: Private seat/home journals retain immutable sequenced decisions, native entry proofs, receipts and ACKs, closed epochs, stable identities, retired floors, authority changes and request results. Capacities provide explicit backpressure. Unacknowledged terminal results replay local finalization before their connection can transmit them.

rules.detail: Both endpoints pin fleet-authenticated Ed25519 identities, exact subject/operation grants and a durable control epoch. Seat-initiated bidirectional websocket sessions drain retained receipts and authority changes before new work. Observe and Stop use current exact native custody; borrowed Stop detaches without signaling a shell. Start grants, configuration and commands explicitly return light-node-start-not-supported, with no enabled remote launch path. Program credentials stay host-local and forward request-bound assertions through the real home claim writer and retry-receipt transaction.

compatibility.detail: The protocol is versioned and mismatched versions, pins, scope and epochs fail closed. Unconfigured full nodes keep their existing startup and credential path. Do not roll an enabled journal back to a binary that does not enforce its authority and replay fences; retain its state and roll forward.

downtime.detail: This change performs no production deployment, membership retirement, graph offload or CPU-target claim. Transport loss does not stop native processes or PTYs.

manual.detail: Opt in with matching home/agent light_node_session configuration and the existing fleet identity. Command administration remains guarded owner-local Unix only. Keep the previous home endpoint and signing identity available until the paired receipt/authority/native-custody drain completes. Graph-free remote Start is the next separate reviewed slice, not an enabled fallback in this release.

recovery.detail: Reconnect and restart replay durable custody, never re-enter a retired execution or invent a replacement identity. Unknown entered custody blocks epoch replacement until positive exact-generation closure. A signed retained-epoch barrier-only response recovers a lost final Ready/ACK without permitting old work. Stable request retries retain their local/home result; sending an HTTP response is not an invented consumer acknowledgement. Added real SQLite/network, native PTY and Bun program fixtures; hosted Linux evidence and exact-head independent review are required before treating the gates as verified.
